name: Data Science
description: Python-first data science environment with JupyterLab, pandas/numpy, and a local MySQL instance for practising SQL alongside Python analysis.

notes.git: Version control for notebooks and analysis scripts. Also enables DVC (Data Version Control) for tracking datasets.
notes.python: Primary language. pandas + numpy cover 95% of data manipulation needs; scikit-learn covers classical ML.
notes.docker: Run MySQL and other services in containers instead of installing them natively — keeps the host clean.
notes.mysql: Relational database for structured datasets and SQL practice. Essential for data engineering and ETL pipelines.
notes.dbeaver: GUI SQL client. Run queries, browse schemas, and export results without leaving the desktop.
